## Core idea

Scientific calculators commonly use **EXP**, **EE**, or **×10ˣ** to enter a power of 10. [[1, pp. 15–16]](../../references.qmd#ref-grob2016)

For **4.7 × 10⁻⁶**:

1. enter **4.7**
2. press the exponent key
3. enter **-6**

The exponent key already represents the **×10ⁿ** part. Do not enter another **×10** first. [[1, pp. 15–16]](../../references.qmd#ref-grob2016)
